book.name: METIU
book.title: Yeisu Wasane Dodohobine Metiu wana Luluweli

content: Farisi ge Sadiusi Nunuwadiye Yeisu I Ginawi Pamali Yauyawate
Farisi ge Sadiusi topadine si luwom Yeisu heine, nuwadiye si hamnohon, iyete si nga, “Gen u ginawi pamali yauyawate hotiya, iloke ha lapu tolosuwok lam gaisi i hudi Helak heine.”
Yeisu i golase halingadiye i nga, “Hebe parae wana sauge dobiyek bwen hu nga, ‘Beniyan i mahave, kaiwane bulubulu i dabarairai,’

ge hebe henanai bwen hu nga, ‘Bwele wesi i dau, kaiwane bulubulu i dabarairai ge i tege.’ Bosowaimiu bulubulu hana hao hu yeuneyan ge hu lapu, age sauge gane Helak i hotei hana hetutuhi taine bosowaimiu hana hao hu deyeuneyan ge hu delapu.

Sai yauyauleine humiu, taine hu demiyemiye Helak heine, iyete nunuwamiu hetutuhi a ginawi kaiwamiu. Agegene taine hetutuhi hotiya bwele a degiyau heimiu, iyege yete gane i youmate profet Jona heine. Sohode hedi, nau bwele a suwoyuk hedi.” Habeto Yeisu i seyokid ge i yogo.
Farisi ge Sadiusi wedi Yis Lihuine
Sauge si hadopanek, topadavae si nuwodon taine bred hotiya si delohowo.
Yeisu i liwo heidiye i nga, “Matamiu i mwaun ge hu yehemiu Farisi ge Sadiusi wedi yis kaiwane.”
Topadavae si pelihulihu-yanid si nga, “I liwo sohode ti yo kaiwane taine ta deholuwom bred hotiya.”
Yeisu i lapu ege wedi lihu, bwen i liwo heidiye i nga, “Lemi goru taine i dekai! Mwatan ge hu pelihulihu-yanmiu bred kaiwane.
Age habe taine nuwamiu i desapu? Tab hu nuwohasik veto a pieneene-yan bred pwahi-lime bobode paib tausan kaiwadiye? Han tuwoi hana yogowo nabwa-piye hu howo?
Tab hu nuwohasik veto a pieneene-yan bred pwahi-pik (7) bobode po tausan kaiwadiye? Han tuwoi hana yogowo nabwa-piye hu howo?
Mwatan ge nuwamiu taine i desapu nau taine a delihulihu heimiu bred kaiwane? Agegene nau a nga, ‘Hu yehemiu Farisi ge Sadiusi wedi yis kaiwane.’ ”
Habeto topadavae si lapu taine i delihulihu tage si yeheid yis gane bred kaiwane, agegene i nga si yeheid Farisi ge Sadiusi wedi papalapu kaiwane.
Pita I Gopayoumate Yeisu Iye Mesaiya
Yeisu i lok i la hiyebe Sesariya Filipai he hana ganahao, habeto i gotayakid wana topadavae totone lihuine, i nga, “Bobode si nga tage Tolomo Natune iye sega?”
Bwen si golase halingane si nga, “Topadine si nga huwo Jon Tobaptais, topadine si nga huwo Ilaija, ge papaine hedi si nga huwo Jeremaiya o hebe profet hotiya hedi.”
I liwo heidiye i nga, “Age humiu, hu nga tage sega nau?”
Saimon Pita i golase halingane i nga, “Huwo Mesaiya, Helak yawedine ganganine Natune.”
Yeisu i liwo heine i nga, “Saimon Jona natune, Helak i muloluyaniwo! Kaiwane nuwotu ga ya bobode he panayawi taine si degiyau heim, agegene Tamau he bulubulu i giyau heim.
Nau a liwo heim, huwo Pita,
iloke he pak ya pwatane bwele a pamidi lo ekalesiya, ge Seitan wana boda taine wedi gaisi tage si dekai lake.

Bwele a giyau heim Helak wana bagalogugui hana ki; iloke heto sahe gane u tepahad he panayawi, bwele Helak i tepahad he bulubulu, ge heto sahe gane u taeman he panayawi, bwele Helak i taeman he bulubulu.”
Habeto Yeisu i gopagaisiid wana topadavae tab tolomo hotiya wana wase si egiyau tage iye Mesaiya.
Yeisu I Gopayoumate wana Mate kaiwane

He sauge ga yake ge i lok, Yeisu i gopayoumate wana topadavae heidiye i nga, “Gen a la Jerusalem, iloke Judiya wedi todedei, topowo lalahine ge Logugui hana topapalapu bwele si patilao-yau suwok, habe bobode si lopamateyau bwen he yan ho-tuwonine a suwoyuk hedi.”
Pita i sehape Yeisu si la si mivevek, bwen i topahad i nga, “Guyau, tab sohode ti yo! Bigi ya tab i eyoumate heim.”
Habeto Yeisu i galahaik, i liwo Pita heine i nga, “Seitan, u miyokau! Huwo sohode bagasopiyele heyau, kaiwane lam nuwotu taine i delok Helak he wana nuwotu, age i lok bobode he wedi nuwotu.”
Habeto Yeisu i liwo wana topadavae heidiye i nga, “Hebe hotiya nuwane i dumuyai heyau, gen i boleu totone wana dohob, i hiyewo wana koros
ge i dumuyai heyau.
Kaiwane sega hebe nuwane totone yawedine i pwamwad, bwele i supwahao, agegene sega hebe yawedine i supwahao nau kaiwau, bwele yawedine i paidi.
Mwatan hana dohob hebe tolomo hotiya i howo panayawi bwabwaligane i logugui-yan, agegene yawedine suwok i supwahao. Taine bosowaine bigi hotiya i dehowo ge i depamaise pahavile yawedine.
Kaiwane Tolomo Natune i eluwom bwaine Tamane wana wasewase ge he-bwaine wana anelose-yan, habeto i giyau bobode hoyowate maisadiye sohode he wedi ginawi.
Tolosuwok a liwo heimiu, bobode topadine sidiye mwage he ya gen si paidi Tolomo Natune i eluwom bwaine ge wana logugui, muyai habe si mate.”

footnotes.text: Yeisu he wana sauge, hebe tolomo hotiya i hiyewo wana koros, iye i ela mate kaiwane. Ta hiyewo wada koros hana sapu te ta taemanide puyowo ge mate heine.
